rs_hopping_to_fractcell
void rs_hopping_to_fractcell(
diverge_model_t* 
m,
int* 
N1,
int* 
N2,
int* 
N3
)

map hopping parameters and model to supercell and allow matrix supercells wrt. to the old lattice vectors:

S1 = m->lattice[0] * N1[0] + m->lattice[1] * N1[1] + m->lattice[2] * N1[2] S2 = m->lattice[0] * N2[0] + m->lattice[1] * N2[1] + m->lattice[2] * N2[2] ...

modify model accordingly; operate on hopping parameters, lattice, orbitals, and positions; leave anything else as-is.

In case N2 == N3 == NULL, make call to rs_hopping_to_supercell with N1 as nr.
